sloka: अश्मभिः परिभिन्न अंगः पादपैर् आहतो भृशम् ।राम बाणेन च आक्रान्तो जीवित अंते मुमोह सः ॥४-१९-२॥
transliteration: aśmabhiḥ paribhinna aṁgaḥ pādapair āhato bhṛśam ।rāma bāṇena ca ākrānto jīvita aṁte mumoha saḥ ॥4-19-2॥

translations.english: Severely battered by stones, hit by trees and pierced by Rama's arrow, Vali lost consciousness as the end of his life was nearing.
translations.hindi: वह बाण से मारे गए और हाथी की तरह गिरे हुए वालि के निकट जा, उससे लिपट गई
